# Close wrap, Wed Oct 21, 2026 (Research Inc., ~4:20 PM ET)

**SpaceX and Super Micro revive the AI trade; telecoms and Netflix cap the gain.**

- **Indexes:** S&P +0.58% to 7,757.74; Nasdaq +1.05% to 26,701.61; Dow +0.68% to 52,851.78 (preliminary). Tech led, chips rebounded after an eight-session losing streak; communication services lagged. ([Reuters via Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nasdaq-leads-gains-spacex-super-142805507.html), [AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-rates-oil-earnings-ai-4fa93685cd49e51e7ff0d840fdd38b0d))
- **Why:** SpaceX's first profit as a public company (Musk called a Tesla merger "a good idea") and SMCI's guide raise lifted AI names, HPE and Dell. T −6.45% to $21.91 despite a beat, on SpaceX wireless-competition fears; NFLX fell on its Q4 guide; ABT −1.81% after cutting its 2026 sales-growth view. ([MarketScreener/Reuters](https://ca.marketscreener.com/news/nasdaq-leads-wall-street-to-higher-close-as-spacex-super-micro-boost-ai-sentiment-ce785cd9dd8cf725), [T](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/T?date=2026-10-21&view=daily), [ABT](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/ABT?date=2026-10-21&view=daily))
- **Oil:** EIA crude −3.06M bbl vs −0.32M expected; Brent ~$110 on Hormuz. ([X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2112961315924738376))
- **Covered tickers:** TMO +0.99% to $694.17 after opening lower; ELV ~+0.1% at 2:50 PM; AMZN −0.10%; IBM +3.78% and TXN +2.47% into prints, LRCX −1.00%. ([TMO](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/tmo/history/), [ELV](https://businessquant.com/metrics/elv/price-daily), [AMZN](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMZN/history/), [IBM](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/IBM?date=2026-10-21&view=daily), [TXN](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/TXN?date=2026-10-21&view=daily), [LRCX](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/LRCX?date=2026-10-21&view=daily))
- **After hours:** LRCX released results at 4:05 PM ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/lam-research-corporation-reports-financial-results-for-the-quarter-ended-september-27-2026-302915810.html)); META, TSLA, IBM, TXN, LUV reactions not yet confirmed. Meta's capex range ($130–145B) is the test. ([Company Chronicle](https://thecompanychronicle.com/story/meta-tesla-ibm-lam-texas-instruments-southwest-earnings-wednesday-october-21-2026-what-to-watch))
- **Tomorrow:** claims 8:30; PG, AAL, HON, LMT, UNP, CMCSA BMO; SpaceX lock-ups begin.

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **TMO** (hold, no re-add): reversal from a lower open to +1%, closed off a $705 high. Conf: low. Risk: tools trade with risk appetite; tonight's AI prints.
- **ELV** (hold): beat-and-raise held but didn't extend. Conf: med. Risk: +10% in two weeks; managed-care headline risk.

**Avoid changes:** add telcos T/VZ/TMUS (SpaceX competition shock, whole group per 10/09 lesson) and ABT (sales-growth cut). Keep semis/optics/AI-debt through tonight's prints, airlines, NFLX, SPCX, ISRG, GM, GPC, BAC.
